mapper.select: SELECT building.id, building.building_code, building.building_name, building.gender_restriction, building.education_level_scope, building.resident_scope, building.enabled, COALESCE(MAX(floor.floor_number), 0) AS floor_count FROM dormitory_building building LEFT JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id=building.id WHERE building.id=#{buildingId} GROUP BY building.id, building.building_code, building.building_name, building.gender_restriction, building.education_level_scope, building.resident_scope, building.enabled FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.id=room.floor_id WHERE floor.building_id=#{buildingId} AND ( (#{gender}<>'MIXED' AND room.gender_restriction<>#{gender}) OR (#{educationScope}<>'MIXED' AND room.education_level_scope<>#{educationScope}) OR (#{residentScope}<>'MIXED' AND room.resident_scope<>#{residentScope}) )
mapper.update: UPDATE dormitory_building SET building_code=#{buildingCode}, building_name=#{buildingName}, gender_restriction=#{gender}, education_level_scope=#{educationScope}, resident_scope=#{residentScope}, enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{buildingId}
